That I'm glad you removed the "memetic" from the article. Unawares of its previous versions, I read it today and thought "Good lord, a decent mental effect SCP and it's not memetic memetic memetic memetic! Praise be to various shiny people sitting up on a cloud!"

It is a little superpowers-y, even if it's superpowers-with-extreme-downsides, but I still think it's okay. About the only thing I'd suggest is altering the bit about the Death Scream vectoring the infection. Just a little. That seems to be the only lingering bit of "meme what makes you crazy and die", and even that's completely salvageable… add in some stuff about it knocking people who sense it out cold and when they wake up they've immediately progressed to the "surface thoughts" level, and make it so that people can possibly be infected just by long contact of getting sent thoughts, and suddenly it's not some meme-thing anymore… it's your brain turning on its telepathic activity ability because it's being used.

item.content:encoded:
It's not a meme, though. This falls under the umbrella of "weird mind shit". This is not an idea of any kind.

The vector for SCP-405 is the subject's final mental vocalisation, identified by most observers as a "Death Scream." This vocalisation occurs at the moment of death, regardless of cause, and has a range of at least 200 m, although the more advanced the disease the greater the range. Individuals who hear this telepathic signal are infected with SCP-405.

This right here, this mechanism of spread completely precludes it being memetic.

Addendum 405-01: Request use of SCP-148 in containment rooms. -Agent ██████
Denied, SCP-148 stocks are low enough as it is and we can treat anyone caught in the radius of a SCP-405 termination. In addition memetic readings predict terminal phase activation is a strength ████ signal, requiring ██ of SCP-148 to shield. -O5-█

Then there was telekill. What part of THE GOGGLES DO NOTHING is so hard to understand? Furthermore, what does memetic readings mean?

item.content:encoded:
Thinking about it, perhaps if I go through the train of logic behind this SCP, why I think it is scary, it might awsage a few fears.

I was in bed, it was 3:30 am. I was awake. This was not my fault, I was desperate for sleep, but my flat makes where being loud. Again. For the 3rd night in a row. I thought to myself, man, what if this never ended? What if they NEVER shut up?

Three (rather more sleep filled) days later, SCP-405.
